reviews.title: No search feature
reviews.text: Why do you have an app where there is no search feature to look up the drink you want to make.  Worthless.

reviews.title: Pretty lame
reviews.text: Force you to have to have the subscription now for almost every drink

reviews.title: WAAAY overpriced!
reviews.text:
Too few ingredient options to load and consequently (or there just aren’t that many installed) too few cocktail recipes.

I’d say there are better online options and suspect this is a team of 1 working part time.

That’s not a BAD thing…. except for the price charged.

Interface is very good, content disappointing.

This Ap should be $4.99/year.

reviews.title: Too many paid recipes!
reviews.text: I got this app and am disappointed that an annual $50 fee is required for full access. The description didn’t mention limited availability unless you pay, so I’ll probably delete it and find something else that doesn’t require such a high price.

reviews.title: Amateur at best
reviews.text:
Looked up two classic American cocktails and they’re wrong
The Sazerac always uses Rye, not cognac 
The Rob Roy always uses sweet vermouth, not dry
